**F1 reproduced before correction:** four individual model/prompt/input/tool mutations and their combination each passed with one completion; [predeclared expectations](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f1-expectations-0145.json), [unchanged-checker observations](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f1-pre-0145.json).
**F1 corrected:** [attachment checks](../benchmark/verify_attempt_evidence_0143.py#L139) now join the model, common prompt, complete original-input inventory and canonical tool content to pinned source values; completion reuses those checks at lines 271–276.
All five reproduced variants now reject with zero completions; literal four-record and tool-error controls remain incomplete; the consistent control still completes one. The pinned plan has two slots, so literal-four-record and combined-four-join probes explicitly cover the review wording without changing grouping.
`python3 -I benchmark/verify_attempt_evidence_f1_0145.py`: **exit 0**, eight new cases, all 92 unchanged saved controls and 60 retained grouping controls pass; [execution](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f1-regression-0145.json), [final observations](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f1-post-final-0145.json).
The first correction altered missing-evidence diagnostic accounting; [preserved failure and adjudication](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f1-adjudication-0145.json) identify a correction defect, not a harness error. It was fixed without weakening any saved control.
Starting commit `4d177993bf1ba87ff4a1cddc6d6d0fc70835eb23`; [starting SHA256](artifacts/attempt-evidence-start-0145.json) match #659. Reports #663/#659 were read; #663's ledger/script/variants were not uploaded (record 0144: zero artifacts), remain unavailable and were not reconstructed.

[Correction note](../benchmark/attempt-evidence-f1-0145.md) lists every documentation edit and before/after hashes; [final audit](artifacts/attempt-evidence-f1-final-0145.json) confirms exactly this scope, unchanged controls/source pins, whitespace pass and files below 2 MB. JSON edits touch only the two contract descriptions.
Failed-attempt retention, absent/zero-byte distinction, unresolved attempts, separate D1–D4 denominators, legacy schema/null reasons and grouping boundary remain intact; no retry, selection or stopping policy is authorized. No evaluator ran, as restricted; no index promotion or owner request.
Expectations followed review exposure: no blind/model-unseen claim. Actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero; costs unavailable; `benchmark_ready=false`.

## What next

The next shaper should order separate changed-scope review of exactly the five files above. Resume from the correction note and saved pre/final evidence; avoid repeating successful probes, reconstructing missing reviewer artifacts, grouping review replay, builders/evaluator or readiness work. Whole-method review and owner acceptance still precede product implementation.
